acceptanceCriteria: The system displays the promo code discount amount for the return trip line item in the Mozio email confirmation when a promo code is applied to a return trip ticket order.
The system displays the promo code discount amount for both the outbound and return trip line items in the Mozio email confirmation when a promo code is applied to a return trip ticket order.
The system calculates the promo code discount amount for the return trip using the same discount logic applied to the outbound trip, ensuring consistency between both portions of the round trip.

The system renders the promo code discount line with the correct currency symbol and formatted amount for the return trip in the email confirmation, matching the formatting used for the outbound trip.

The system displays a promo code discount amount of zero for the return trip in the email confirmation when the promo code discount evaluates to zero for that portion, without omitting the discount line.
The system correctly displays the promo code discount amount for the return trip when the promo code is a percentage-based discount, reflecting the percentage applied to the return trip fare.
The system correctly displays the promo code discount amount for the return trip when the promo code is a fixed-amount discount, reflecting the fixed amount applied to the return trip fare.

The system handles the case where the promo code discount amount for the return trip exceeds the return trip fare by capping the displayed discount at the return trip fare value, showing a maximum discount equal to the fare.
The system includes the promo code identifier or code label alongside the discount amount for the return trip in the email confirmation, consistent with how it is displayed for the outbound trip.
The system does not display a promo code discount line for the return trip in the email confirmation when no promo code has been applied to the order.

notes: Defect: promo code discount amount not displayed for return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmation. The code path flows through discount application (apply-report-discounts.service.ts), reservation mapping (submit-reservations.mappers.ts), and finally sanitization/dispatch to Mozio (map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts). The returnDiscount field exists in the type and is processed by sanitizeDiscount, but the upstream discount application or mapping likely fails to populate the return trip discount correctly before it reaches the sanitizer.
